verdict.rationale: Together AI ships first-party documented agent-skills for coding agents (12 domain-specific skills teaching correct SDK/model usage) plus an official Docs MCP server for live documentation lookup directly inside the editor, alongside OpenAI-compatible API docs and function-calling/agentic tool-loop guides that let frameworks integrate easily. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the agent-skills/MCP server working in practice, and explicit named integration guides for popular frameworks like LangChain/LlamaIndex.
